info.description: One access window. scope: personal = a reader's own purchase; org_contract = what an organization has paid for (organization set, user empty); org_member = an Org Admin's grant to one member, which must sit inside an org_contract window. scope is derived in lifecycles.js when the caller doesn't send it, so epaper-transaction needs no changes. A row with revokedAt set grants nothing. Every row opens exactly ONE publication (publication). A bundle purchase therefore creates one row per publication, and an organisation contract has one row per publication with its own seats and amount.

publication.description: The one publication this row opens.

edition.description: Set for single_issue purchases: the exact edition bought.

amountAllocated.description: This publication's share of the payment, frozen at sale (bundle split) or entered by hand (organisation contract line). Revenue reports sum this.

seats.description: org_contract rows only: seats paid for on this publication.

reference.description: org_contract rows only: invoice / LPO reference.
